description:
CIF value, duty and import VAT, in GBP.

Send the goods value as `goods_gbp`, or as `goods` with `currency`; amounts
in another currency are converted at the Bank of England rate TDE holds,
stated under `fx_rate` with its date. Give `duty_rate_pct`, or a
`commodity_code` and `origin` for goods entering the UK: the rate is then
read from the UK tariff and stated under `duty_lookup`. When more than one
code fits, `choose_code` lists them and no total is given. A rate that
cannot be found is asked for, never set to 0. For goods entering another
country, `duty_rate_pct` and `vat_rate_pct` are required.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.

claim_preference.description: True if the goods qualify for the origin's tariff preference.
claim_preference.title: Claim Preference

commodity_code.description: 10-digit UK commodity code, 6-digit HS code, or a product description.
commodity_code.title: Commodity Code

currency.description: ISO code of goods, freight and insurance: USD, GBP, CNY, INR, EUR, THB or MYR.
currency.title: Currency

destination.description: Country the goods enter. Default UK.
destination.title: Destination

duty_rate_pct.description: Duty rate, percent of CIF. Overrides any looked-up rate.
duty_rate_pct.title: Duty Rate Pct

origin.description: Country the goods come from, e.g. China.
origin.title: Origin

vat_rate_pct.description: Import VAT rate, percent. 20 for the UK when unset.
vat_rate_pct.title: Vat Rate Pct

name: landed_cost
title: Landed cost
